Game Idea
I created a simple Guess the Number game.

The computer generates a random number between 1 and 10 and asks the player to guess it.

Prompts Used
Prompt 1
"I'm a first year C++ programmer, and we've just learned if statements. My instructor wanted me to ask you, as a C++ expert, how to build on that to make a simple game."

Prompt 2
"How do I make a random number function I can call repeatedly?"

Prompt 3
"How can I use a loop to make sure the user enters a number between 1 and 10?"

Prompt 4
"Show me a simple game that uses functions, loops, if statements, and random numbers."

AI Suggestions Used
Created a random number function.
Used a while loop to check for bad input.
Added a play-again loop.
Used if/else statements to determine win or loss.
What I Learned
How to create and use a function.
How to generate random numbers with rand().
How to use a while loop for input validation.
How to use a do-while loop to repeat a game.
How to combine loops and if statements to make a simple game.
